cases.input: A premium running shoe lands on wet black stone after rain; show water displacement, material detail and a clean hero ending without changing the logo or sole shape.
A courier carrying a red parcel runs through a crowded night market after hearing a motorcycle approach; one continuous shot ends as she slips through a closing metal gate.
A creator records a casual vertical phone video comparing two iced coffees, takes one sip, reacts naturally, and points to the cup she prefers.
Observational footage of commuters leaving a suburban station during sudden rain; people open umbrellas at different times while the camera operator steps under an awning.

Animate an existing portrait: the subject hears something off-screen, shifts her eyes first, then turns her head slightly; the curtain behind her moves from a small draft. Preserve face, clothes and framing.
Two friends sit in a quiet café. One slides a key across the table and says, 'You keep it.' The other pauses before replying, 'Are you sure?' Cup and room sounds stay synchronized.

Three-shot micro-story: a bicycle courier checks an address, rides through a narrow lane, then hands the same dented package to a shopkeeper. Preserve courier, jacket, bicycle and package damage across cuts.
